FROM tasks task JOIN gc_user updated_by_user ON task.updated_by_user_id = updated_by_user.id JOIN gc_user_info updated_by_user_info ON updated_by_user.info_id = updated_by_user_info.id JOIN video_events video_event ON video_event.id = task.video_event_id JOIN gc_user u ON video_event.owner_id = u.id JOIN gc_user_info user_info ON u.info_id = user_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file updated_by_user_avatar_file ON updated_by_user_info.avatar_file_id = updated_by_user_avatar_file.id LEFT JOIN sys_file user_avatar_file ON user_info.avatar_file_id = user_avatar_file.id LEFT JOIN task_choices task_choice ON task_choice.task_id = task.id AND task_choice.is_deleted = false WHERE task.id = #{id} AND task.is_deleted = false ORDER BY video_event.video_time, video_event.order_number
